results.title: Northallerton space firm joins in tests on satellite data for safe hydrogen expansion
results.description: AmbaSat Ltd and Teesside University have landed European funding to explore how satellites could help support the safe expansion of green hydrogen infrastructure.

results.description: He said that engineers spend another big chunk of time in product reviews, design meetings, and aligning with different business teams.
